name: Hôtel Henriette
summary: A courtyard hotel on a quiet cobbled street near the Mouffetard market, with rooms the hotel designs one by one.
description: Hôtel Henriette stands at 9 rue des Gobelins, a short walk from the Mouffetard street and the Latin Quarter. The hotel describes a small Left Bank house: 32 bedrooms designed individually, a flowered courtyard, and a desk that stays open through the night. It is the kind of address that looks considered without pretending to be a palace. The rate printed here is the Small Double Room Booking.com showed for two adults on 10–11 November 2026.
facts: 32 individually designed rooms, according to the hotel
A short walk from Les Gobelins metro
